Name: Bug Fables Plushies for Alternative Textures
Author: TerraTerraCotta
Description:
[size=4][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size]
Created largely as a gift to my loving partner, who absolutely adores Bug Fables. Using custom Sprites from the Spriter's Resource

Vi, Lief, or Kabbu can be painted over the[b] Small Junimo Plush [/b]or the [b]Futan Bear. [/b]I wanted to give multiple options since the Futan Bear is easier to obtain, but the Small Junimo Plush has also been used by other Alternative Texture mods.

[u][b]CREDITS[/b][/u]
Skins were reformatted, tested, and put together by TerraTerraCotta.
[i](These Skins were tested using Alternative Textures)[/i]

Sprites were created by [url=https://www.spriters-resource.com/submitter/Spikey-Valentine/]Spikey-Valentine[/url] on the Spriter's Resource
